prompt:
A digital top-pan balance reads -0.12 g when empty.
(a) State the type of error and its sign. [1]
(b) A glass beaker containing salt is placed on the pan, and the balance displays 65.48 g. Calculate the corrected mass of the beaker and salt. [1]

mark_scheme.criterion: Part (a): Negative zero error (or systematic error with negative sign / -0.12 g).

hints: In part (a), note whether the reading when empty is positive or negative.
In part (b), subtract the signed zero error: 65.48 - (-0.12).
solution: (a) Negative zero error. (b) Corrected mass = 65.48 g - (-0.12 g) = 65.60 g.
teacher_walkthrough: (a) Since the balance reads -0.12 g when the true mass is 0 g, it has a negative zero error.
(b) Corrected reading = raw reading - (zero error) = 65.48 - (-0.12) = 65.48 + 0.12 = 65.60 g.

provenance.independence_statement: Authored drill testing algebraic correction of a negative zero error on a balance.
